question: Famous dance personality Kelucharan Mohapatra is associated with which of these dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odissi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra **was a renowned dancer and choreographer who is known for his contribution to the **Odissi dance form**.
 
• He was born in **1926 in Raghurajpur, **a small village in Odisha, India, and started his dance training at the age of **10 under** the tutelage of **Guru Pankaj Charan Das.**
 
• Kelucharan Mohapatra is credited with** reviving the Odissi dance form** and bringing it to the national and international stage.
 
• He received several awards and accolades for his contribution to the field of dance, including the **Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form originating from **northern India.**

 
 
• **​It **emphasizes f**ootwork and rhythmic movements. **
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam **is a classical dance form from **southern India.**
 
 
• **It **emphasizes** graceful movements and facial expressions.**
 
 
 
• **Kathakali **is a classical dance form from** Kerala**.
 
 
• It combines dance, music, and drama to** tell stories from Hindu mythology.**
